action.description: existing: Fyniq's chart has it; create: the set-up creates it.

cash_flow_line.description: An account to create: its cash-flow line.

default_gst_code.description: An account to create: its default GST code.

function.description: An account to create: its function (COGS, R&D, S&M, G&A or Other).

fyniq.description: The Fyniq account it maps onto, or is created as, by code.

money_account.description: An account to create: whether money moves through it.

name.description: The workbook's name for it; ignored in a change.

report_group.description: An account to create: its report group.

row.description: Its row on the Accounts sheet; ignored in a change.

type.description: Fyniq's type: asset, liability, equity, revenue or expense; the workbook's Cost of Sales, Other Expense and Tax are expense and Other Income revenue.

workbook.description: The workbook's account code: the entry's key.

workbook_type.description: The workbook's type, such as Cost of Sales; ignored in a change.
